name: Parringtonia
sum: Parringtonia is an erpetosuchid archosaur known from a single specimen from the Anisian Manda Beds of Tanzania.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: NHMUK R8646, from the Manda Beds, Tanzania.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Huene 1939
